name: starnet
description: A living pixel-art station where real AI agents do real work. Local-first desktop agent harness - bring your own key, watch your crew actually run.
one_liner: A game-like desktop app that shows your AI agents as little characters working in a virtual station, so you can watch at a glance who's doing what, using your own AI keys.
buyer: A solo consultant or indie developer running several AI agents at once for different clients who wants a single visual screen to check progress instead of five separate terminal windows.
business_use_cases: A freelance 'AI ops' consultant runs client agents inside it and screen-shares the dashboard on client calls as a tangible sign of 'here's your AI team at work'.
A small dev shop uses it internally as a morale/visibility tool so non-technical founders can see agent progress without reading logs.
A solo indie hacker running multiple side projects uses it to track which project's agent is stuck versus actively working.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid, hosted/managed version with team seats for agencies.
Sell branded/white-labeled versions to agencies who want it in their own visual style for client demos.

steal_this: Set it up for your own 2-3 active AI side projects this weekend and use the visual board as a demo when pitching an 'AI-run studio' to a client.
